clue.text: Delivery charge for a flowering plant?

definitions.text: Delivery charge for a flowering plant?

parts.words: Delivery charge for a flowering plant?
parts.note: read as the invoice a baby-bringing bird might send, written with a possessive: the bird's bill for delivering an infant

explanation.surface: A florist's customer queries the fee for having a plant delivered.
explanation.walkthrough: Folklore says the stork delivers babies, so its delivery charge would be the stork's bill; the plant of that name has a long beak-shaped fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic description of a wild geranium relative named for its beaked seed pods.

clue.text: Inspect and put back casual shirt

indicators.note: the word for put is turned to read backwards

parts.note: to set something is to put it down
a T-shirt is a casual shirt, giving T

explanation.surface: An instruction to check a casual top and then return it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' reverses SET to TES.
explanation.definitionFit: To try something out is to examine or check it.

clue.text: Seeing a painter on holiday is most uncommon

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece sits on top of the other

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a painter
a rest is a break or holiday

explanation.surface: Spotting an artist taking time off is very unusual.
explanation.walkthrough: RA stands for Royal Academician, a member of the Royal Academy of Arts in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative of an adjective meaning scarce or seldom seen.

clue.text: Decline to join evil top man

parts.note: sin is wrongdoing or evil
a king is the man at the top of a realm

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to ally with a wicked boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Decline' looks like refuse; it means a falling off, as in sinking health.
explanation.definitionFit: A gradual dropping or deterioration, as in a sinking feeling.

clue.text: Article for which one paid up

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: to have met a bill is to have paid it

explanation.surface: A purchased article that someone settled the bill for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses MET to TEM in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: An individual thing or object in a list or collection.

clue.text: More behind an old palace

parts.note: later means further behind in time

explanation.surface: An old palace that is further back.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lateran Palace in Rome was for centuries the residence of the popes.
explanation.definitionFit: The papal palace in Rome, beside the basilica of St John Lateran.

clue.text: Dealt with TT races and scrambles

indicators.note: the letters of these words are mixed up, like motorcycle scrambles

explanation.surface: An official handled both the TT motorcycle races and the scrambles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scrambles' rearranges TT RACES AND. The TT races are motorcycle races on the Isle of Man; scrambles are off-road motorbike races too.
explanation.definitionFit: To have conducted business is to have handled or carried it out.

clue.text: It's OK to tax commercial transport

parts.note: OK means satisfactory or good
to tax something is to strain it

explanation.surface: Someone approves a levy on business vehicles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tax' is not a levy here but a verb meaning to strain.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway service carrying freight for trade.

clue.text: A small group, or it could be

indicators.note: says the letters of the words or it might be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: Someone hesitates over whether a gathering counts as a small group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' rearranges OR IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Three performers or people together form a small ensemble.

clue.text: Having the power to contract for temporary accommodation without phone

parts.note: as can mean for, in the sense of in the capacity of

indicators.note: here in its old sense of outside, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: a tent is shelter put up for a short stay
to ring is to phone someone

explanation.surface: A clause about the right to sign a deal for a campsite that has no telephone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, giving TRINGENT. 'contract' suggests signing a deal, but here it means shrink.
explanation.definitionFit: An astringent substance draws body tissue together, shrinking it.

clue.text: A hearing device Edward's got

parts.note: the ear is the organ we hear with
Ned is a common short form of Edward

explanation.surface: Edward has acquired a hearing aid.
explanation.definitionFit: Money one has earned is money one has gained or received.

clue.text: Drivers attracting attention in London?

definitions.meaning: motorists sounding their horns to get notice

explanation.surface: Motorists honking for notice somewhere in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: TOOTING is a district in south London, which is the second definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Sounding a car horn is hooting, and the same name belongs to a place in south London.

clue.text: Criterion for a Shakespearean role

definitions.meaning: a standard against which things are judged
the court jester in As You Like It

explanation.surface: Asking for the yardstick for a part in a Shakespeare play.
explanation.definitionFit: A stone once used to test gold, hence any benchmark; also the clown in As You Like It.

clue.text: Makes too much of the American president's position

definitions.meaning: the president is placed above the States, a whimsical second reading

explanation.surface: A complaint that the American president's stance is overblown.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as OVER STATES, the second reading jokes that the US president sits above the States.
explanation.definitionFit: To exaggerate is to claim something beyond the truth; split, the word places someone above America.

clue.text: Bars put right in the entrance

indicators.note: one letter is placed inside the word for the entrance

parts.note: a gate is an entrance

explanation.surface: Bars have been fitted correctly at the doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: A fireplace grid is made of metal bars.

clue.text: Daring to vex a social worker

parts.note: to gall someone is to irritate them
the ant is a social insect that works in a colony

explanation.surface: It takes nerve to annoy a member of the social services.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' is not a council employee but an insect living in a colony.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe brave, spirited conduct in the face of danger.

clue.text: Antelopes, including the little Oriental kind

indicators.note: the word for antelopes contains the other letter

parts.note: gnus are African antelopes, also called wildebeest
little suggests an abbreviation: E for Eastern

explanation.surface: Antelopes, among them a small Eastern variety.
explanation.definitionFit: A biological rank grouping species, so a category or type.

clue.text: Colourful but unsophisticated

definitions.meaning: having a colour, namely that of grass

explanation.surface: Someone is described as vivid yet naive.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a colour, and also a word for a raw, inexperienced novice.

clue.text: Accustomed to being in employment

definitions.meaning: familiar with, as in the phrase with to
currently employed or put to service

explanation.surface: A worker has grown familiar with having a job.
explanation.definitionFit: We are said to be habituated to something with this word plus to; it also means utilised.

clue.text: Exceptionally neat mount

indicators.note: the word neat is to be taken in an unusual form, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Praise for an unusually tidy mountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exceptionally' rearranges NEAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Sicily's active volcano is a mountain; mount is a standard name for one.

clue.text: A drink that's really way-out!

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a kind of way
taken as written

explanation.surface: A drink described as truly eccentric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'way-out' (eccentric) splits into way, giving ST, and out.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark strong beer brewed with roasted malt.

clue.text: A slight wound that's no handicap

definitions.meaning: a shallow graze on the skin
in golf, a player with zero handicap

explanation.surface: A minor injury that turns out not to be a hindrance.
explanation.definitionFit: A light graze, and also the zero-handicap standard of a top golfer.

clue.text: The couple most woe-afflicted

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are troubled, so their order is disturbed

explanation.surface: The most miserable pair imaginable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'afflicted' rearranges MOST WOE.
explanation.definitionFit: A pair of people together, as a couple is.

clue.text: Awfully posh Italian opening church refuge

indicators.note: the word posh is treated badly, its letters jumbled
only the opening letter of the word Italian is taken

parts.note: CE stands for the Church of England

explanation.surface: A grand Italian church refuge has just opened.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awfully' rearranges POSH into HOSP; 'opening' takes the I of Italian.
explanation.definitionFit: A home caring for the dying, and historically a shelter for travellers.

clue.text: Town getting a point over about the air

parts.note: S is south, a compass point
wind is moving air
on can mean about, concerning

explanation.surface: A town gets a mention for its stance on the atmosphere.
explanation.definitionFit: A large town in Wiltshire, in southern England.

clue.text: Turned up issue about irate gypsies

indicators.note: the reversed word goes round the other piece
in a down clue, read upwards so the word is reversed

parts.note: a son is one's issue, offspring
mad means angry or irate

explanation.surface: An angry son arrives among wandering travellers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turned up' gives NOS, read upwards in this down clue, and 'about' wraps it round the angry piece. 'gypsies' means wanderers in general.
explanation.definitionFit: Wanderers without a fixed home, like travelling peoples.

clue.text: Grace is in love with a liar

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the words that follow, spanning them

explanation.surface: A girl called Grace has fallen for a dishonest man.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run through 'with a liar'. 'Grace' looks like a girl's name; it is one of the three Graces of Greek myth, so 'love' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the three Charites of Greek mythology, also a Muse.

clue.text: Some of them may embrace a girl

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few of them might hug a girl.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'embrace a girl' as definition; the definition is just 'a girl', and 'embrace' merely supports the hiding, since the two words embrace the name.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's first name, so it can stand for a girl.

clue.text: Large family — many will get canned!

annotationWithheld.why: Large family — many will get canned! : L (many) inside CAN, but 'canned' must give both the letters CAN and the containment, one word doing two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: Large family — many will get canned!

clue.text: Time to give encouragement in a mundane way

parts.note: tempo is the time or speed of music
to rally is to rouse and encourage

explanation.surface: A call that the moment has come to cheer people up in an ordinary way.
explanation.definitionFit: Temporal means worldly or secular, as opposed to spiritual, so the adverb means in an earthly manner.

clue.text: The man turning the French on

indicators.note: the combined words are turned round to read backwards

parts.note: le is French for the
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man switches on the French.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' reverses LE + ON (LEON).
explanation.definitionFit: A male first name, so it can stand for a man.

clue.text: Even Athens can be divine!

indicators.note: says the letters of the two words may be arranged into a new form

explanation.surface: Enthusing that even the Greek capital can be glorious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can be' rearranges EVEN ATHENS.
explanation.definitionFit: Something heaven-sent seems a gift from the gods, so sublime or godly.
